comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 regulations specify a 55 EC Academic Core, a 95 EC Major and a 30 EC Minor. The Free Major permits courses from the humanities, social sciences and sciences. This example uses the 15 EC thesis option.

Venice Philosophy, International and Economic Studies double-degree track

routeSelection.basis: The generic target is one English-language 180 EC degree. The regulations distinguish majors but no formal tracks within this degree. The Free Major preserves the broadest permitted disciplinary choice and was selected without considering UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest option owns interdisciplinary breadth, research and societal challenges. Health and human behaviour, and institutions and markets, each support a distinct 180 EC UCR option. The business courses cover accounting, finance, entrepreneurship, cross-border business law and effects of AI adoption, with limited international management. Arts and Culture, human-centred AI and the Venice double-degree interest remain separate directions after three feasible options.

alternatives.label: Liberal Arts and Sciences: Society, Culture and Environment
alternatives.labelReason: Foundations in biodiversity, history and philosophy support conservation and later work on climate and environmental governance. Statistics, data analysis and qualitative methods support documentary and historical research.
alternatives.concept: Study how societies respond to shared challenges. Connect history, ethics, law and politics with biodiversity, conservation and climate science, and use data analysis, qualitative research and documentary to investigate those issues.
progression: Foundations in biodiversity, history and philosophy support conservation and later work on climate and environmental governance. Statistics, data analysis and qualitative methods support documentary and historical research.

alternatives.label: Health, Life Sciences, Neuroscience and Human Behaviour
alternatives.labelReason: The life science and brain and behaviour gateways precede laboratory biology, psycholinguistics, neuroscience and health courses. Statistics supports the later systematic review and meta-analysis course.
alternatives.distinctness: Biomedical science and cognitive and health research replace the general option’s concentration on history, institutions, culture and environmental challenges.
alternatives.concept: Study how biological systems, brains and behaviour shape health. Build from cell biology, neuroscience and psychology to physiology, immunology, disease mechanisms, mental health and research synthesis.
progression: The life science and brain and behaviour gateways precede laboratory biology, psycholinguistics, neuroscience and health courses. Statistics supports the later systematic review and meta-analysis course.

alternatives.label: Politics, Law, Economics and Business
alternatives.labelReason: Introductory economics, politics, law and research methods support macroeconomics, microeconomics, public economics, econometrics and international and EU law. Company finance and the economics of AI add business applications.
alternatives.distinctness: Economics, finance and political and legal institutions take priority over environmental science or biomedical and cognitive study.
alternatives.concept: Study how institutions govern markets and societies. Combine political philosophy, law, international relations and history with economics, company finance, cross-border business law and the effects of AI on businesses and labour markets.
progression: Introductory economics, politics, law and research methods support macroeconomics, microeconomics, public economics, econometrics and international and EU law. Company finance and the economics of AI add business applications.

audience.programmeDescription: University College Groningen offers an English-language degree in Liberal Arts and Sciences. This example uses the Free Major, which lets students combine humanities, social sciences and sciences while completing a common core and a minor.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR option combines social and cultural study with ecology and climate science. Two further options concentrate on health and behaviour or on institutions and markets. Groningen has a separate project each year and a required thesis.
